scope.method: Read-only JSON comparison of the preserved before version with the frozen current template, followed by semantic inspection of only the seven localized replacements in five modern text fields. No reproducer, finalize, app, test, network or database operation was run.
scope.writes: This new report only; template, before snapshot and original science pass report left untouched.

unchanged_rest_comparison.interpretation: The already reviewed ideal-system assumptions, energy-zero statements, conservation conditions, motion sequence, energy equalities and fixed-system scaling are unchanged outside the localized wording identified below. Their full scientific review was not repeated.

affected_checks.assessment: Only the added narrative math wrapper is removed. The displacement symbol and its equilibrium origin retain the same meaning; the source amplitude and initial potential-energy formulas are untouched.

In the existing equilibrium-based displacement context, 最大的位移大小 denotes maximum displacement magnitude, not a signed minimum. Only the reference token and adjacent layout spaces change. The velocity-amplitude relation and its use in checking the same equation (1.28) remain identical.

conclusion: No confirmed scientific regression in the affected formatting and descriptive wording. The original substantive science pass remains applicable to the unchanged content. This report does not claim that the strict token preservation gate or adapt-finalize has passed.
